p.src: 1  The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
u.src: 1  The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

p.src: 2  “Behold, I have called by name Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.

en: “Behold, I have called by name Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.
u.src: 2  “Behold, I have called by name Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.

p.src: 3  I have filled him with the Spirit of God, in wisdom, and in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all kinds of workmanship,

en: I have filled him with the Spirit of God, in wisdom, and in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all kinds of workmanship,
u.src: 3  I have filled him with the Spirit of God, in wisdom, and in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all kinds of workmanship,

p.src: 4  to devise skillful works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in bronze,

en: to devise skillful works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in bronze,
u.src: 4  to devise skillful works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in bronze,

p.src: 5  and in cutting of stones for setting, and in carving of wood, to work in all kinds of workmanship.

en: and in cutting of stones for setting, and in carving of wood, to work in all kinds of workmanship.
u.src: 5  and in cutting of stones for setting, and in carving of wood, to work in all kinds of workmanship.

p.src: 6  Behold, I myself have appointed with him Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan; and in the heart of all who are wise-hearted I have put wisdom, that they may make all that I have commanded you:

en: Behold, I myself have appointed with him Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan; and in the heart of all who are wise-hearted I have put wisdom, that they may make all that I have commanded you:
u.src: 6  Behold, I myself have appointed with him Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan; and in the heart of all who are wise-hearted I have put wisdom, that they may make all that I have commanded you:

p.src: 7  the Tent of Meeting, the ark of the covenant, the mercy seat that is on it, all the furniture of the Tent,

en: the Tent of Meeting, the ark of the covenant, the mercy seat that is on it, all the furniture of the Tent,
u.src: 7  the Tent of Meeting, the ark of the covenant, the mercy seat that is on it, all the furniture of the Tent,

p.src: 8  the table and its vessels, the pure lamp stand with all its vessels, the altar of incense,

en: the table and its vessels, the pure lamp stand with all its vessels, the altar of incense,
u.src: 8  the table and its vessels, the pure lamp stand with all its vessels, the altar of incense,

p.src: 9  the altar of burnt offering with all its vessels, the basin and its base,

en: the altar of burnt offering with all its vessels, the basin and its base,
u.src: 9  the altar of burnt offering with all its vessels, the basin and its base,

p.src: 10  the finely worked garments—the holy garments for Aaron the priest, the garments of his sons to minister in the priest’s office—

en: the finely worked garments—the holy garments for Aaron the priest, the garments of his sons to minister in the priest’s office—
u.src: 10  the finely worked garments—the holy garments for Aaron the priest, the garments of his sons to minister in the priest’s office—

p.src: 11  the anointing oil, and the incense of sweet spices for the holy place: according to all that I have commanded you they shall do.”

en: the anointing oil, and the incense of sweet spices for the holy place: according to all that I have commanded you they shall do.”
u.src: 11  the anointing oil, and the incense of sweet spices for the holy place: according to all that I have commanded you they shall do.”

p.src: 12  The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
u.src: 12  The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

p.src: 13  “Speak also to the children of Israel, saying, ‘Most certainly you shall keep my Sabbaths; for it is a sign between me and you throughout your generations, that you may know that I am the LORD who sanctifies you.

en: “Speak also to the children of Israel, saying, ‘Most certainly you shall keep my Sabbaths; for it is a sign between me and you throughout your generations, that you may know that I am the LORD who sanctifies you.
u.src: 13  “Speak also to the children of Israel, saying, ‘Most certainly you shall keep my Sabbaths; for it is a sign between me and you throughout your generations, that you may know that I am the LORD who sanctifies you.

p.src: 14  You shall keep the Sabbath therefore, for it is holy to you. Everyone who profanes it shall surely be put to death; for whoever does any work therein, that soul shall be cut off from among his people.

en: You shall keep the Sabbath therefore, for it is holy to you. Everyone who profanes it shall surely be put to death; for whoever does any work therein, that soul shall be cut off from among his people.
u.src: 14  You shall keep the Sabbath therefore, for it is holy to you. Everyone who profanes it shall surely be put to death; for whoever does any work therein, that soul shall be cut off from among his people.

p.src: 15  Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day is a Sabbath of solemn rest, holy to the LORD. Whoever does any work on the Sabbath day shall surely be put to death.

en: Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day is a Sabbath of solemn rest, holy to the LORD. Whoever does any work on the Sabbath day shall surely be put to death.
u.src: 15  Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day is a Sabbath of solemn rest, holy to the LORD. Whoever does any work on the Sabbath day shall surely be put to death.

p.src: 16  Therefore the children of Israel shall keep the Sabbath, to observe the Sabbath throughout their generations, for a perpetual covenant.

en: Therefore the children of Israel shall keep the Sabbath, to observe the Sabbath throughout their generations, for a perpetual covenant.
u.src: 16  Therefore the children of Israel shall keep the Sabbath, to observe the Sabbath throughout their generations, for a perpetual covenant.

p.src: 17  It is a sign between me and the children of Israel forever; for in six days the LORD made heaven and earth, and on the seventh day he rested, and was refreshed.’”

en: It is a sign between me and the children of Israel forever; for in six days the LORD made heaven and earth, and on the seventh day he rested, and was refreshed.’”
u.src: 17  It is a sign between me and the children of Israel forever; for in six days the LORD made heaven and earth, and on the seventh day he rested, and was refreshed.’”

p.src: 18  When he finished speaking with him on Mount Sinai, he gave Moses the two tablets of the covenant, stone tablets, written with God’s finger.

en: When he finished speaking with him on Mount Sinai, he gave Moses the two tablets of the covenant, stone tablets, written with God’s finger.
u.src: 18  When he finished speaking with him on Mount Sinai, he gave Moses the two tablets of the covenant, stone tablets, written with God’s finger.
